about: Otterburn Park is a city in Montérégie, Quebec, on the Richelieu River at the foot of Mont Saint-Hilaire—not Mont-Saint-Hilaire itself. Riverside parks, a commuter-rail suburb, and views of the Monteregian hill define this small South Shore city. About 8,000 people live in Otterburn Park.
